integrity: Proof combines explicit finite-field code enumeration with mathematical topology, canonical covering geometry and the published Tan intermediate-cover irregularity theorem; scientific statements do not rely on experimental extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Only normal complex quintics with exactly 17 A2 cusps and two 12-cusp three-divisible subsets meeting in seven are covered; no universal nonabelian cover, arbitrary 17-cusp case or canonical map degree is asserted. Full historical uniqueness not established.
title: The smooth degree-nine abelian cover of seventeen-cusp quintics
